segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so North Ridge is at 42 seats, annual, standard support, and they want the order form by Friday so procurement can cut it in their 8/30 batch.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. Is the number still $54,600 or did they take out the onboarding hours?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Still $54,600. I added the note back to deal desk on the 18% year-one discount, so I’m not sending the order form until that field flips in the pricing sheet.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Got it. Term is twelve months from 9/15, right? No auto-renew change?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Right, 9/15 to 9/14 next year, net 30. They did ask for the mutual NDA attached to the DPA, so I dropped the redline comment in the legal thread again before lunch.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Their security guy also asked about data residency. Did we already send the standard response?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, I sent the help article and the SOC packet yesterday. He seemed fine with US-only hosting, no custom language there.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Cool. What about billing setup, since they’re using that reseller in Ohio?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: I put the reseller address and tax cert back on the billing ticket this morning; the invoice schedule in the CRM is empty until they pick the right tax treatment.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay, then once those fields are clean, you can send PDF plus the checkout link. Customer sounds ready otherwise.
